extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the browser toolbar and web store. Keep 'Claude' untranslated as a brand name.

extensionDescription.message: See your Claude usage limits at a glance - session, weekly, and Claude Code - without opening the settings page.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description for the web store listing. Keep 'Claude' and 'Claude Code' untranslated as brand names.

extensionTitle.description: Tooltip title shown when hovering the toolbar icon.

versionLabel.description: Label preceding the extension version number in the popup header.

metricFiveHour.description: Label for the 5-hour rolling usage window.

metricSevenDay.description: Label for the 7-day usage window covering all models.

resetsIn.description: Shown under a usage bar; $TIME$ is a duration like '2h 15m'.

resetsAt.description: Shown under a weekly usage bar; $TIME$ is an absolute day/time like 'Mon 2:29 PM'.

resetsSoon.description: Shown when the reset time is now or in the past.

updatedAgo.description: Freshness line in the popup; $TIME$ is a duration like '2m'.

updatedJustNow.description: Freshness line when data is under a minute old.

staleData.message: Showing older data - last refresh failed.
staleData.description: Shown when the latest refresh failed but a previous snapshot exists.

refreshNow.description: Button that fetches fresh usage data immediately.

errSignedOut.message: No claude.ai session found. Sign in to claude.ai (or just visit it once), then click Refresh.
errSignedOut.description: Error banner when no session cookie is available. Visiting claude.ai also repopulates the org cookie for users who are already signed in.

signInLink.description: Action link shown inside the signed-out banner.

errBlocked.message: Could not reach the usage API. Open claude.ai in a tab and refresh.
errBlocked.description: Error banner when the background fetch is blocked and no claude.ai tab is open.

errNetwork.message: Network error while fetching usage data.

errBadShape.message: Unexpected response from claude.ai - the usage API may have changed.
errBadShape.description: Error banner when the API response has no recognizable usage fields.

noData.message: No usage data yet. Click Refresh to fetch.
noData.description: Empty state before the first successful fetch.

badgeTitleSummary.description: Toolbar icon hover title; $SUMMARY$ is like 'session 42% · week 61%'.

contributeGithub.description: Footer link to the project repository.

privacyPolicy.description: Footer link to the privacy policy.

whatsNew.description: Title of the changelog page and the popup link to it.

privacyShort.description: Short privacy link label in the changelog footer.

latest.description: Tag shown on the newest changelog entry.

subtitleWelcome.message: Thanks for installing Claude Usage Tracker! Here's what the extension does and how it evolves over time.
subtitleWelcome.description: Changelog subtitle shown right after installation.

subtitleDefault.message: Track how Claude Usage Tracker has evolved. Each release below highlights the most important improvements shipped to you.
subtitleDefault.description: Changelog subtitle shown when opened after an update or manually.

socialLinksAriaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the social links row on the changelog page.

websiteAriaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the personal website icon link.
